source_manifest.sql:
SELECT a.id AS album_id, a.event AS album_event, a.sgf_content,
       a.source_path, r.id AS raw_event_id, r.parsed_data->>'series_core' AS series_core
FROM kifu_albums a JOIN kifu_raw_event_values r ON r.raw_value = a.event
WHERE a.event_id IS NULL AND r.category = 'unclassified_pending' AND a.id > :after_id
ORDER BY a.id LIMIT :limit

limitations: GN and GC are correlated imported SGF metadata, not two independent sources.
Event sources verify type/year/schedule, not every captured SGF game. No association approval is made.
Same exact core may contain multiple albums: approvals must use listed album IDs and source hashes, never broad alias matching.
Rank2007 generic event type does not establish定段vs升段 or edition27.
No deduplication: multi-album cores remain separate games.
